messages:
Kamal (eng-runtime): follow-up from the Garnet postmortem. RCA: intermittent VPC peer flaps + on-prem NAT translation drift caused session pinning failures and triggered Dedicated pool isolation. Need owners, short mitigations, and tests.

Priya (eng-sre): I can own peer-flap detectors + quick alerting rule. Will add packet capture hooks and a pager runbook. ETA: 2026-04-08.

Ellen (eng-platform): I'll build a preflight validator for on-prem NAT symmetry and a CI gate for Dedicated onboarding. ETA: 2026-04-15.

Rafael (customer-success): Customer agreed to a 30-min maintenance window for short mitigations (reduce idle timers, deprioritize flaky peer). I'll coordinate comms and get sign-off.

ops-bot: maintenance scheduled by Rafael: "Garnet peering mitigation" 2026-04-09T03:00:00Z - 2026-04-09T03:30:00Z (ref: #maint-180900).

Kamal (eng-runtime): Action items (add tracker links/PRs into comments):
- G1: Peer-flap detectors + alerting (owner: Priya) due: 2026-04-08 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-4021
- G2: Runtime KV fallback + sticky-session fix (owner: Kamal) due: 2026-04-11 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-4022
- G3: On-prem NAT symmetry validator + CI (owner: Ellen) due: 2026-04-15 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-4023
- G4: Interim maint + comms + rollback plan (owner: Rafael) due: 2026-04-07 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-4024

Priya (eng-sre): pushed initial BGP/sniffer artifacts to RD-4021 and added a short detection rule: `if peer_bgp_down_count > 2 in 5m then page SRE`.

Ellen (eng-platform): prototype validator uploaded to RD-4023: `redwood-validate --nat-symmetry config.yaml`. Will add as a gating job.

Kamal (eng-runtime): I'll open RD-4022 PR with `--enable-kv-fallback` feature flag and unit tests that simulate NAT drift.

Rafael (customer-success): customer signed off on the maintenance; I'll send pre-window note and include rollback steps. They asked for post-maintenance summary within 2 hours.

ops-bot: rollback artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-rollback/garnet/rollback-2026-04-09.tgz. Docs: https://docs.redwood/internal/garnet/rollback.

Kamal (eng-runtime): scheduling weekly follow-ups until all tickets are closed: Thursdays 14:00 UTC. Priorities: 1) limit customer impact (G4/G1), 2) ship runtime fallback (G2), 3) gate onboarding with validator (G3). Ping me if blocked. :white_check_mark:
